narr: Showers and thunderstorms developed in West Virginia on the afternoons of July 13th through 15th in the midst of weak disturbances passing through the area. Strong wind gusts accompanying storms resulted in multiple downed trees across the state. Flash flooding also blocked sections of a road in Raleigh County on the 13th while another isolated instance of flash flooding occurred on the 15th in Clay County. Storms tapered down with the loss of daytime heating after sunset each evening.
ev: High water blocked two places along the 400 block of North Sandbranch Road.

Portions of Dundon-Widen Road were impassable between the towns of Widen and Dille for a time due to high water. The water approached a few homes near the road and washed out portions of the driveway.
lsr: High water is blocking two places along the 400 block of N Sand Branch Road.
Widen Dille Rd impassable for a time with water approaching house and washing out a couple of driveways. Report from Clay Co CERT.
